lore.text: Damian Wayne is the son of Talia al Ghul, daughter of Ra's al Ghul, leader of the League of Assassins, and Bruce Wayne, aka Batman. Conceived when Ra's was trying to convince Batman to be his heir, Bruce was unaware Talia was pregnant when he left. Talia kept Damian's existence a secret from Bruce, and the boy was raised with the training of the League of Assassins almost from birth. When Talia felt he was old enough, she allowed Damian to go to Gotham City and meet his father. While Batman was surprised to learn he had a son, he readily took him in, knowing it would be important to teach Damian that the ruthless ways of the League of Assassins were not the only way to view the world. Damian initially was annoyed with the mercy Batman showed enemies, but came around to his way of thinking.

Damian felt he was more than qualified to be the next Robin, as he'd begun training younger and had more experience than the others. Batman could see his son wouldn't take no for an answer. But soon after Damian became Robin, Batman was seemingly killed by Darkseid. The first Robin, Dick Grayson, now called Nightwing, took over as Batman. While Damian initially was critical of Dick, they soon bonded and formed a relationship like brothers. Eventually, Batman returned, having actually been sent back in time by Darkseid's omega beams, and resumed the mantle of Batman, with Damian at his side as Robin.

Damian had a more contentious relationship with Tim Drake, who was Robin when Damian arrived. Tim took on the new identity of Red Robin, but mistrusted Damian and feared Batman would not be properly on guard against his son. The tension between them boiled over after Batman's apparent death, when Damian hacked into a list Tim kept of potential threats to the Bat-Family and saw he was on it. The two of them got into a brutal fight that ended when Nightwing interrupted and pointed out they were battling in front of the theater where Bruce Wayne's parents were killed, disrespecting everything he stood for. The two Robins formed a reluctant truce, and after fighting side by side long enough, came to genuinely trust and respect each other, though they still can't resist trading verbal jabs.

Batman and Damian began battling the criminal organization Leviathan, which they learned was headed by Talia, Damian's mother. Damian refused to leave his father's side and join his mother, disappointing her. She revealed that she had created a clone of him, the obedient Heretic, and aged him to full adulthood. Batman tried to get Damian to stay out of the final fight with Talia, but he refused. During the battle, the Heretic killed Damian. Talia planned to resurrect him in one of her family's Lazarus Pits and make him loyal to her, but Batman rescued his son's body and brought him back to life using technology from Apokolips, Darkseid's home.

Damian began to socialize with other young superhumans, including the Teen Titans, whom he joined when he learned his cousin, Mara al Ghul, was part of a group called the Demon's Fist that had chosen various Titans as targets for their initiation into the League of Assassins. Damian became a valued member of the Titans, and when the team disbanded, he assembled a new team. But that group unraveled when they discovered Damian had a secret prison under their headquarters where he'd imprisoned the worst criminals they defeated. Once again, Damian's upbringing with his mother and grandfather had come between him and those close to him.

Damian met Superman's son, Jonathan "Jon" Kent, aka Superboy. While initially Robin and Superboy's personalities clashed, they ended up working together against such threats as Kid Amazo and Rex Luthor, an alien child who idolized Lex Luthor and tried to assemble a team of young villains modeled after famous criminals. Robin and Superboy had no choice but to resolve their differences when their parents declared they could only go out crime-fighting without their fathers if they were with each other. They ended up becoming as close as brothers, and when Wonder Woman had a daughter, they took her under their wing, ensuring the heroic trinity of Superman, Batman, and Wonder Woman would continue to another generation.

guide.overview: A powerful **physical DPS**, Robin unleashes **a flurry of random attacks** and **racks up crits**. He gains more Crit Rate alongside [Bat Family] allies.

legacyPieces.name: T-Sphere Weakness Analyzer
legacyPieces.reason: Increases Crit Rate and Crit Damage, making it the perfect fit for Robin's multi-hit, crit-driven burst attacks.

legacyPieces.name: Gas Derringer
legacyPieces.reason: Boosts Attack and Accuracy, helping Robin's slashes and Batarangs land more reliably.

legacyPieces.name: Lawton Rifle Scope
legacyPieces.reason: Enhances Attack and Crit Rate, boosting Robin's burst when finishing off weak enemies or diving the backline.
